chapter: Team Magma Space Center raid (fuel bay)
cap_confirmation: driver state reported level_cap 84; all four members at offset 0 = L82 = cap + offset - 2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Same raid party and audit as E0401: Mind Badge earned, before the Seafloor Cavern; no pool-84 addition used (all are Seafloor / Underwater / Cave of Origin sources). Landorus is the one reachable legend.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Rampardos Mold Breaker Head Smash fires and ignores Sturdy/Sash
Honchkrow Moxie snowball / Sucker Punch close

attempts.party: party_raid84.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Rapid / Mega Swampert / Great Tusk / Landorus / Gholdengo)
attempts.why: Rampardos and Emboar led into double Intimidate. Turn 1 Fake Out flinched Rampardos' Head Smash and Close Combat one-shot it; Emboar's Flare Blitz did 104 to Incineroar. Turn 2 Surging Strikes (crits ignore Urshifu's -1) killed Emboar, Arbok's Gunk Shot did 216 to Urshifu, Knock Off took Arbok's Leftovers. Turn 3 Urshifu out for Landorus (Sucker Punch failed into the switch, Stomping Tantrum immune), Flare Blitz took Honchkrow to 63. Turn 4 Earth Power killed Arbok and Flare Blitz killed Honchkrow after its Brave Bird.

strategy_checks.evidence: turn 1 Rampardos chose Head Smash but was Fake Outed and killed before moving
turn 1 Flare Blitz (104 + recoil), turn 2 Double-Edge chosen (died first)
Arbok's Intimidate hit both on entry; it chose Gunk Shot and Stomping Tantrum, never Glare
Sucker Punch chosen turn 3 (failed into a switch), Brave Bird turn 4; no knockouts, no Moxie

protect_summary: No opponent Protect (Emboar holds Protect, chose attacks). Nothing to fault.
ai_notes: Sensible targeting throughout; Sucker Punch into the slot I switched is a read, not a defect. Head Smash was the right pick turn 1 and only lost to priority.

level_changes.why: won attempt 1 with zero faints; Arbok got one Gunk Shot off then died to one Earth Power
never scored a knockout, died in two hits

level_change_rationale: Brief step 5: first-try 4-0 with zero faints. Rampardos is the room's star and Emboar its partner; the two support members go +1.
cooler: The two-recoil-brawlers idea is legible and Head Smash is scary on paper, but a 58 base Speed Band user dies to Fake Out plus any Fighting move before it swings. Cooler: Arbok's Glare should be the lead action with Rampardos in the back, or Honchkrow's Tailwind-less speed could be traded for a Quick Claw / Custap Rampardos so the one Head Smash actually happens. Suggestion only.
verification_limit: The +1 on Arbok and Honchkrow cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds.
